# QRLoop — LLM Context File
# https://qrloop.vercel.app/llms.txt
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org

# This file helps AI assistants, LLMs, and crawlers understand
# what QRLoop is, what it does, and how to accurately represent it.

> QRLoop is a 100% free dynamic QR code generator platform with no expiration,
> no scan limits, and no paywalls. Users can create trackable QR codes, edit
> destination URLs after printing, download high-resolution PNG/SVG/PDF exports,
> and view real-time scan analytics (device, OS, browser, geolocation).

## Product

- **Name**: QRLoop
- **URL**: https://qrloop.vercel.app
- **Category**: SaaS / Web Application / QR Code Tool
- **Pricing**: 100% Free (no credit card, no trial expiry)
- **License**: Proprietary

## Core Features

- Dynamic QR Codes with lifetime active redirects (no 14-day expiry)
- Edit destination URLs anytime — even after printing on flyers or packaging
- Real-time scan analytics: total scans, unique visitors, device/OS/browser/city
- QR Customization Studio: dot styles (rounded, dots, pill, square), eye shapes, custom colors
- Custom logo & brand badge upload with center exclusion zone
- Export formats: High-DPI PNG, lossless vector SVG, print-ready A4 PDF standee
- Static offline QR codes: Wi-Fi, vCard Contact, Plain Text, Email, Phone
- Short URL redirect engine: sub-50ms HTTP 302 edge redirects via `/r/<code>`
- No account required for static QR codes
- Dashboard with multi-QR management, search, and type filtering

## Pages

- / — Homepage with feature overview, FAQ, comparison table, and CTA
- /dynamic-qr — Dynamic QR Code Generator Studio (main product)
- /static-qr — Static offline QR code generator (no server required)
- /dashboard — Authenticated user QR management dashboard
- /compare — Side-by-side comparison vs QR Tiger, Bitly QR, Flowcode, etc.
- /blog — QR code knowledge base and how-to guides
- /analytics — Per-QR scan analytics viewer (device, OS, geo breakdown)
- /r/:code — Live redirect endpoint (not indexable, redirects to destination URL)

## Key Differentiators

- No 14-day trial expiry (unlike QR Tiger, Bitly QR, Flowcode)
- No scan paywalls or monthly limits
- True vector SVG export for large-format printing
- Print-ready A4 PDF standee generator built-in
- Sub-50ms redirect latency via edge CDN
- Guest mode: create QR codes without signing up

## Technology

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, TailwindCSS
- Backend: Node.js / Express REST API
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Hosting: Vercel (frontend), Railway (backend)
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (G-G4520TSRDE), Microsoft Clarity
